title: Partial Observability Degradation: How Monitor Performance Degrades When Agent Tool Calls Are Partially Hidden
original_idea: Run standard SHADE-Arena LLM monitor under four observability conditions: full trace, tool-call names only, arguments only, alternating step access. Measure AUC degradation in each condition. Identify which information modality is most critical for detection.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear safety-relevant question: which information modalities are most important for monitoring? Directly informs monitoring system design decisions about privacy vs. detection trade-offs. Practical and actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simple data masking experiment: take existing trajectories, mask different parts, run LLM monitor, compare AUC. No ML training. Standard string manipulation and API calls. Very accessible for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Very narrow: 4 masking conditions, one monitor, one metric (AUC). Clear deliverable (degradation curve across conditions). Tightly defined experiment.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
